title: Keep a terminal at a name `@inventarch/db` reads from becoming the controlling terminal
summary: `@inventarch/db` opens installed distribution files, `.ia/workspace.json`, authored package sources, the workspace file `readWorkspaceBytes` reads and the check evidence file `.ia/work/evidence/<authored revision>.ia` before it judges them. A terminal device put at one of those names could, on some POSIX systems, become the process's controlling terminal when it was opened. It now cannot; the device is still refused, or for evidence ignored, as before.
